image_description: A close-up view of a grey whale's tail flukes emerging from the ocean surface, creating splashes. The skin is dark grey with lighter mottling and barnacle patches. The tail is broad with a central notch. No head or full body is visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is completely outside the frame; only the tail and posterior back are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible skin on the tail and back shows characteristic mottled grey coloration and lighter patches consistent with barnacle/cyamid encrustation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the back leading to the tail shows a series of small humps (knuckles) rather than a single dorsal fin, matching grey whale anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the posterior section and tail are visible; the full spindle shape cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with the Head_and_Face checkpoint; texture and coloration match expectations.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth and interior of the whale are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are located anteriorly and are not visible in this tail-focused shot.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail flukes are clearly visible, showing a broad structure with a distinct central notch and smooth edges.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Close inspection reveals rough texture and bumps on the skin surface consistent with callosities/barnacles.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The water droplets and splash dynamics appear slightly 'clumped' and lack the fine, chaotic detail of real high-speed photography, suggesting minor generative smoothing.
Background blur is uniform but lacks natural lens bokeh characteristics, appearing more like a digital Gaussian blur.
